LanguageData.LP_NecroticTouch.label: necrotic touch
LanguageData.LP_NecroticTouch.description: An archite gene granted by the lich ritual. Melee hits on fleshy creatures that are still alive stun them for 2 seconds. Works unarmed and with melee weapons; doesn't affect mechanoids, necromantic constructs, liches, corpses or buildings, and ranged attacks don't trigger it.
LanguageData.LP_NecroticTouch.customEffectDescription: Melee hits on the living: stunned for 2 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_NecroticBody.label: undead body
LanguageData.LP_NecroticBody.description: An archite gene granted by the lich ritual. Vacuum and cold resistance 100%, immune to hypothermia and frostbite, needs no food, sleep or recreation. After death, as long as the bound phylactery is intact, the body automatically re-forms near the phylactery after 3 game days, with no ritual table, materials or other characters needed. Original identity, skills, relationships and genes are kept; psyfocus recovers from zero.
LanguageData.LP_NecroticBody.customEffectDescriptions: Cold resistance: 100% (immune to hypothermia and frostbite).
While the bound phylactery is intact, automatically revives 3 game days after death.
